The emotion on an astronaut's face the first time they see the Moon this close
caption:
Four NASA astronauts flew around the Moon in April 2026, the first humans to do that since 1972. This is what it looked like from inside the spacecraft.

The Artemis II crew brought it all back on film: the genuine looks of awe and joy that only come from being that close to the Moon's surface. NASA called it "Moon joy." Hard to argue with that name.
